title: Blue Bird Body Company: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (21,000 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: Skyline Corporation: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (112 affected)
summary: THE LOW STRENGTH ADHESIVE TAPE USED TO SECURE A SHIELD FOR THE WASHING MACHINE MOTOR CAN FAIL. IF THE SHIELD IS NOT COMPLETELY SECURE, SUDS AND WATER CAN GET UNDER THE SHIELD AND TO THE MOTOR SWITCH, CAUSING OVERHEATING OF THE SWITCH.

title: Erwin Hymer Group North America, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:AUXILLIARY GENERATOR (969 affected)
summary: THE GENERATOR EXHAUST PIPE, LOCATED AT THE REAR ROADSIDE OF THE VEHICLE, CAN EMIT HOT EXHAUST GASES FROM A DAMAGED, WORN, DEFECTIVE, OR IMPROPERLY INSTALLED EXHAUST PIPE, MELTING THE ADJACENT POLYETHYLENE STORAGE TRUNK.

title: STEWART & STEVENSON SERV.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR (15 affected)
summary: REGULAR NUTS, INSTEAD OF LOCKING NUTS, WERE USED TO SECURE AN EXTENSION ARM FROM THE FORWARD SIDE OF THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR TO THE WIPER ARM. THE NON-LOCKING NUT CAN LOOSEN AND ALLOW THE EXTENSION ARM TO "SLIP" OFF THE TAPERED SHAFT CAUSING THE WIPERS TO CEASE TO FUNCTION.

title: Shyft Group: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR (169 affected)
summary: THE REAR SUSPENSION, FRONT SPRING HANGER MOUNTING ASSEMBLY MAY FAIL UNDER CERTAIN ROAD CONDITIONS. A HARD SHOCK TO THE REAR SUSPENSION MAY FORCE THE FRONT SPRING HANGER MOUNTING BOLTS TO SHEAR.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (415 affected)
summary: THE SAFETY BELT RETRACTOR DESIGNED FOR THE PASSENGER SIDE OF THE CABIN WAS INSTALLED ON THE DRIVER'S SIDE, AND THE DRIVER'S SIDE RETRACTOR WAS INSTALLED ON THE PASSENGER SIDE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (204 affected)
THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (188 affected)
summary: THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE BOLTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES". THE SEAT ANCHORAGES COULD NOT MAINTAIN LOAD OF 5,000 LBS FOR 10 SECONDS.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:BOOSTER (3,661 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE BOOSTER ASSEMBLIES WERE IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED. THIS CAN CAUSE THE SEPARATION OF THE BRAKE BOOSTER HOUSING DURING A HIGH EFFORT BRAKING MANEUVER.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (5,574 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER FRONT SEAT MANUAL RECLINING MECHANISMS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS." THE SEAT BACK MECHANISMS WILL NOT LATCH UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (3,400 affected)
summary: THE TIRE AND WHEEL SPECIFICATION INFORMATION ON THE CERTIFICATION LABEL INDICATES A MINIMUM TIRE SIZE LARGER THAN THE TIRE ACTUALLY FITTED TO THE VEHICLE. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS."

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: STEERING:LINKAGES:SLEEVE:TIE ROD:ADJUSTABLE (1,526 affected)
summary: THE HIGH STRENGTH -- LOW ALLOY MATERIAL WHICH WAS USED IN THE TURNBUCKLE STYLE CROSS-TUBE AXLE ASSEMBLIES HAS LOW IMPACT RESISTANCE PROPERTIES. THE TURNBUCKLE STYLE CROSS-TUBE ASSEMBLIES ARE THEREFORE SUSCEPTIBLE TO FRACTURE UNDER IMPACT LOADS DUE TO THE COMPONENT'S DESIGN GEOMETRY AND THE LOW IMPACT RESISTANCE OF THE MATERIAL.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:HOSES (33,000 affected)
summary: NISSAN HAS MADE A PRELIMINARY DETERMINATION THAT A DEFECT EXISTS IN ENGINE COMPARTMENT COMPONENT(S) THAT MAY FAIL DUE TO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT HEAT.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES (1,558 affected)
summary: THE TIRES WERE UNDERCURED.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (300 affected)
summary: THE REAR OUTBOARD LOWER SAFETY BELT ATTACHMENT BOLT WAS INADEQUATELY TORQUED ON INSTALLATION.

title: Skyline Corporation: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (371 affected)
summary: DEFECTIVE BATTERY OPERATED SMOKE ALARMS, IN WHICH THE HORN MAY SOUND AT A WEAK OR LOW LEVEL OR MAY NOT SOUND DURING OPERATION, WERE INSTALLED IN THESE VEHICLES.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: STEERING:LINKAGES (1,076 affected)
summary: THE TIE ROD USED ON THE DANA FA-64 FRONT DRIVE AXLE HAS A THREADED SLEEVE TO PERMIT TOE-IN ADJUSTMENT WITHOUT REMOVING AN END. THE TIE ROD BAR IS NECKED DOWN TO INCORPORATE THE SLEEVE. A STRESS RISER IS CREATED AT THE THREADED PORTION OF THE ADJUSTMENT SLEEVE WHICH MAY CAUSE A FATIGUE FRACTURE AND FAILURE OF THE TIE ROD WHERE IT SCREWS INTO THE SLEEVE.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:PASSENG (37 affected)
summary: THE PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG CAN EXPERIENCE AN INFLATOR IGNITION DELAY IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: PACCAR Incorporated: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (307 affected)
summary: AN INCORRECT TOOL WAS USED TO INSTALL PITMAN ARM PINCH BOLTS, RESULTING IN INADEQUATE TORQUE ON THE PITMAN ARM PINCH BOLTS.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING (1,122 affected)
summary: IMPROPER INSTALLATION OF ELECTRICAL WIRING TO THE EXTERIOR LIGHTS (BRAKE LIGHTS, RUNNING LIGHTS, AND TURN SIGNALS) OF THE TRAILER ALLOWS THE STEEL LIFTING CABLES USED TO RAISE AND LOWER THE FOLDING TOP TO RUB AGAINST THE ELECTRICAL WIRING WHENEVER THE TOP IS LOWERED OR RAISED.

title: Trailmobile Canada Limited: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS (150 affected)
summary: THE GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING CERTIFICATION PLATES ARE LABELED INCORRECTLY, STATING THE GAWR AS 20,000 LBS. THE CORRECT GAWR IS 17,000 LBS.

title: Trailmobile Canada Limited: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS (294 affected)
summary: THE GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING CERTIFICATION PLATES ARE LABELED INCORRECTLY, STATING THE GAWR AS 20,000 LBS. THE CORRECT GAWR IS 17,000 LBS.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE (INDICATOR FORWARD OR REVERS (3,154 affected)
summary: A CONDITION EXISTS THAT ALLOWS OIL TO LEAK FROM THE ALL WHEEL DRIVE TRANSFER CASE. LOW OIL LEVELS IN THE TRANSFER CASE CAN CAUSE BEARING DAMAGE AND FAILURE.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (87,000 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.
